=== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is the Facebook profile circular of Jindrich Nepevny (facebook.com/jindrich.nepevny). Identification: exact legal name already on the wiki plus membership in the Star Wars CCG Facebook group. Lives Prague, Czech Republic; works Praha 10; Red 65 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Prague, Czech). The available photograph is an 88-pixel circular; dest it and let the wiki scale it. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook profile screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Jindrich Nepevny Facebook portrait.jpg]].
